jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unserer Corporate Operations und setze das Talent und die Leidenschaft, die dich ausmachen, bei uns ein.

Manufacturing Engineer (Fix-Term, 24 Monate, 80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Dein Beitrag

In dieser anspruchsvollen und wichtigen Rolle sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, dass Produkte aus Entwicklungs- und Änderungsprojekten termingerecht und sauber in die Serienproduktion übergeleitet werden. Sie gewährleisten die effiziente und wirtschaftliche Beschaff- und Produzierbarkeit von Produkten, Baugruppen und Einzelteilen und übernehmen die technische Betreuung der zugeteilten Produkte. Zudem sorgen Sie für eine effiziente Abwicklung von Änderungen und arbeiten mit unseren weltweiten Produktionsstandorten und Lieferanten zusammen. Gelegentliche Reisen (20%) sind erforderlich.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Mitarbeit in Entwicklungsprojekten ab spätestens Meilenstein M2, um produktionstechnische Aspekte zu vertreten

• Planung und Durchführung von Produktions-Line-Validierungen (PLV) sowie Erstellung von Produktionsflowcharts, FMEA und Montageanleitungen

• Konstruktion, Erstellung und Beschaffung von Montage- und Produktionshilfsmitteln sowie Einrichtung von Montagearbeitsplätzen

• Schulung interner und externer Produktionsmitarbeiter in produktionstechnischen Belangen

• Abwicklung und Dokumentation von Änderungen an zugeteilten Produkten, inkl. Fehler- und Ursachenanalyse

• Unterstützung der Einkaufsgruppe bei technischen Fragen und Evaluation neuer Lieferanten

Dein Profil

Wir sind nicht nur auf der Suche nach Fachwissen: Wir suchen nach Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent bei uns umsetzen.

• Mechanische oder elektronische Grundausbildung (z.B. Werkzeugmacher, Polymechaniker oder ähnliches)

• Weiterbildung als Betriebsfachmann BF/TS oder HF wünschenswert

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, mindestens teilweise im regulierten Umfeld

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, SAP-Kenntnisse wünschenswert

• Kommunikative, selbständige, effiziente und praxisbezogene Arbeitsweise

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

• Die Chance, etwas zu bewirken und die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten

• Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

• Spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Starke und einzigartige Unternehmenskultur

• Attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen

Have you ever wondered how your skills and unique background can influence the world of tomorrow? Become part of our Corporate Operations and put the talent and passion that define you to work with us.

Manufacturing Engineer (Fixed-term, 24 months, 80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurich

Your contribution

In this challenging and important role, you will be responsible for ensuring that products from development and change projects are transferred to series production on time and smoothly. You will ensure the efficient and economical sourcing and manufacturability of products, assemblies and individual parts, and provide technical support for the products assigned to you. You will also ensure the efficient handling of changes and work with our production sites and suppliers worldwide. Occasional travel (20%) is required.

Your responsibilities

- Participation in development projects from milestone M2 at the latest to represent production engineering aspects
- Planning and execution of production line validations (PLV), as well as creation of production flowcharts, FMEA and assembly instructions
- Design, creation and procurement of assembly and production aids, as well as setup of assembly workstations
- Training internal and external production personnel in production engineering matters
- Handling and documenting changes to assigned products, including error and root cause analysis
- Supporting the purchasing group with technical questions and evaluating new suppliers

Your profile

We are not only looking for expertise: We are looking for people who put their passion and talent to work with us.

- Basic vocational training in mechanics or electronics (e.g., toolmaker, polymechanic or similar)
- Further training as an operations specialist BF/TS or HF is desirable
- At least 5 years of professional experience, at least some of it in a regulated environment
- Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken
- Very good MS-Office skills, SAP knowledge is desirable
- Communicative, independent, efficient and practical approach to work

What makes working at Tecan unique?

- The opportunity to make a difference and help shape the world of tomorrow
- Working in an international and diverse environment
- Exciting career opportunities
- Strong and unique corporate culture
- Attractive compensation and benefits

Become part of Tecan, certified as a Great Place to Work! Here you can learn more about our certification. Great Place to Work .

We look forward to receiving your online application. For your application, we only need your CV (without a photo and without a cover letter; certificates and diplomas are optional).

We can only consider applications that meet our requirements.

Garantirà che prodotti, gruppi costruttivi e singoli componenti possano essere approvvigionati e prodotti in modo efficiente ed economico e si occuperà dell'assistenza tecnica dei prodotti assegnati. Inoltre, assicurerà una gestione efficiente delle modifiche e collaborerà con i nostri siti produttivi e fornitori in tutto il mondo. Sono richiesti viaggi occasionali (20%).

I tuoi compiti

- Partecipazione ai progetti di sviluppo al più tardi a partire dalla milestone M2, per rappresentare gli aspetti tecnici della produzione
- Pianificazione e svolgimento delle convalide delle linee di produzione (PLV), nonché creazione di diagrammi di flusso della produzione, FMEA e istruzioni di montaggio
- Progettazione, realizzazione e approvvigionamento di attrezzature per il montaggio e la produzione, nonché allestimento di postazioni di lavoro per il montaggio
- Formazione del personale di produzione interno ed esterno sugli aspetti tecnici della produzione
- Gestione e documentazione delle modifiche ai prodotti assegnati, compresa l'analisi degli errori e delle cause
- Supporto al gruppo acquisti per questioni tecniche e valutazione di nuovi fornitori

Il tuo profilo

Non cerchiamo solo competenze tecniche: cerchiamo persone che sappiano mettere a frutto la loro passione e il loro talento con noi.

- Formazione di base meccanica o elettronica (ad es. costruttore di utensili, polimeccanico o simile)
- Formazione continua come tecnico aziendale BF/TS o HF auspicabile
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale, almeno in parte in un ambiente regolamentato
- Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, sia scritti che parlati
- Ottima conoscenza di MS-Office, conoscenza di SAP auspicabile
- Metodo di lavoro comunicativo, autonomo, efficiente e orientato alla pratica

Cosa rende unico il lavoro in Tecan?

- La possibilità di fare la differenza e contribuire a plasmare il mondo di domani
- Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato
- Interessanti opportunità di carriera
- Cultura aziendale forte e unica

Have you ever wondered how your skills and unique background can influence the world of tomorrow? Become part of our Supply Management teams and put the talent and passion that make you who you are to work with us.

Supply Manager - Operations (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurich

Your contribution

As a Supply Manager at Tecan, you are a central part of our Supply Management team and ensure that our material supply runs smoothly. You optimize availability, quality and costs, further develop our supplier relationships and contribute your ideas for efficient processes. Through your commitment, you help us achieve our ambitious departmental and company goals – and delight our customers worldwide.

- Independent procurement and management of suppliers and product lines within the framework of global and local procurement and quality policies
- Optimization of material availability, inventory turnover, quality and costs, as well as the continuous further development of procurement and logistics processes
- Support in negotiating and concluding contracts with suppliers, as well as actively further developing supplier relationships
- Coordination and communication with internal and external stakeholders, including processing Non Conformity Reports and Corrective Actions
- Maintaining and entering procurement master data in the ERP system (SAP R3/S4), as well as implementing change requests and creating item records

Your profile

We are not only looking for expertise: We are looking for people who can put their passion and talent to work with us.

- Completed vocational training in a technical or commercial field
- Ideally, further training as a federally certified purchasing specialist or equivalent
- At least 2–3 years of experience in operational procurement
- Very good command of German and English, both written and spoken
- Experience with SAP R3/S4 and Excel
- You are familiar with the national and international supplier market
- You are confident in negotiations, efficient, practical and self-confident
- Resilience, team spirit, strong communication skills and social competence set you apart
- You are innovative, goal-oriented, reliable and think entrepreneurially
- Flexibility, willingness to learn and openness to new things round out your profile

Responsabile degli approvvigionamenti - Operazioni (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurigo

Il tuo contributo

In qualità di Supply Manager presso Tecan, sei una parte integrante del nostro team di Supply Management e garantisci che il nostro approvvigionamento di materiali proceda senza intoppi. Ottimizzi la disponibilità, la qualità e i costi, sviluppi ulteriormente le nostre relazioni con i fornitori e contribuisci con le tue idee a processi efficienti. Con il tuo impegno contribuisci a raggiungere i nostri ambiziosi obiettivi di reparto e aziendali – e a entusiasmare i nostri clienti in tutto il mondo.

- Approvvigionamento autonomo e gestione dei fornitori e delle linee di prodotto nell'ambito della politica globale e locale di approvvigionamento e qualità
- Ottimizzazione della disponibilità dei materiali, della rotazione delle scorte, della qualità e dei costi, nonché continuo sviluppo dei processi di approvvigionamento e logistici
- Supporto nella negoziazione e nella stipula di contratti con i fornitori, nonché sviluppo attivo delle relazioni con i fornitori
- Coordinamento e comunicazione con gli interlocutori interni ed esterni, inclusa la gestione dei rapporti di non conformità e delle azioni correttive
- Gestione e registrazione dei dati anagrafici relativi agli acquisti nel sistema ERP (SAP R3/S4), nonché attuazione delle richieste di modifica e inserimento degli articoli
- Collaborazione a progetti interni al reparto.

Il tuo profilo

Non cerchiamo solo competenze specialistiche: cerchiamo persone che sappiano mettere a frutto la propria passione e il proprio talento con noi.

- Formazione professionale completata in ambito tecnico o commerciale
- Idealmente, una formazione continua come acquirente diplomato/a federale o equivalente
- Almeno 2–3 anni di esperienza negli acquisti operativi
- Ottima padronanza del tedesco e dell'inglese, sia parlati che scritti
- Esperienza con SAP R3/S4 ed Excel
- Conosci bene il mercato nazionale e internazionale dei fornitori
- Hai ottime capacità negoziali, sei efficiente, pragmatico/a e sicuro/a di te
- La capacità di lavorare sotto pressione, lo spirito di squadra, le doti comunicative e le competenze relazionali ti contraddistinguono
- Sei innovativo/a, orientato/a agli obiettivi, affidabile e hai una mentalità imprenditoriale

Production Engineer (100%)

Männedorf, Switzerland

Your contribution

In this versatile role, you will have technical responsibility for a product portfolio during lifecycle management. With your technical understanding and passion for complex systems as well as your drive for constant improvement, you make a significant contribution to ensuring that our products always meet the highest customer requirements. They act as an interface at the center between internal/external production, research & development, procurement, product management and quality assurance.

• Definition and development of MES (Manufacturing Execution System) processes

• End-to-end implementation and continuous optimization of the MES

• Responsibility for project and sub-project management for complex MES implementations and rollouts

• Technical support of the assigned products from the release of the pilot series to the phase-out.

• Initiation and implementation of mechanical, electronic or software changes together with a team of subject matter experts.

• Error analysis and implementation of improvement measures

• Planning and management of process validations in our production or at suppliers.

• Development and planning of the required production and testing equipment

• Process support and control of the assigned production lines by monitoring key figures

• Ensuring data quality in the ERP system for smooth order processing

• Participation in LCM projects to incorporate the production technology aspects

• Support quality assurance in technical questions

• Support purchasing with technical questions and activities with suppliers and sub-suppliers

Your profile

• Motivation and personal responsibility to continually improve our products and production processes.

• Engineering studies (electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, systems engineering or production engineering) or technician HF electrical engineering or mechanical engineering with at least 5 years of professional experience

• Very good knowledge of production technology, design and logistics

• Professional experience in the regulated medical technology/bio-pharmaceutical, automation, automotive and/or aviation industries

• Very good knowledge of German and English, both spoken and written
